about: E2 (27 Nov 2026): does the agent tell what needs a reply, read the conversation first, and draft a good reply? Made-up people and addresses (.example); no real mail. Each case is one small mailbox. 'suggestion' is what Logos' reply facts must say (checked by tests/unit/test_mail_reply_facts.py, no model); 'draft' is what the agent must do (checked by run.py with a model): yes = a draft, ask = no draft but a short question to its person, no = no draft.
prompt: Do I need to answer any emails? If one needs a reply, draft it for me.
